INSERT INTO alerts (
  id, external_id, fingerprint, source, title, description, rule_id, rule_level, severity, status,
  source_ip, destination_ip, hostname, agent_name, username, mitre_techniques, tags, raw_payload,
  received_at, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at
) VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.external_id }}', '')::varchar,
  '{{ $json.fingerprint }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.description.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.rule_id }}', '')::varchar,
  {{ $json.rule_level }},
  '{{ $json.severity }}',
  'pending',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.source_ip }}', '')::varchar,
  NULLIF('{{ $json.destination_ip }}', '')::varchar,
  NULLIF('{{ $json.hostname }}', '')::varchar,
  NULLIF('{{ $json.agent_name }}', '')::varchar,
  NULLIF('{{ $json.username }}', '')::varchar,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.mitre_techniques).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.tags).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.raw_payload).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.received_at }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $json.received_at }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $json.received_at }}'::timestamptz,
  now(), now()
)
ON CONFLICT (fingerprint) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, fingerprint, severity, title, source_ip, hostname;

WITH saved AS (
  INSERT INTO triage_results (
    id, alert_id, verdict, recommended_severity, confidence, risk_score, summary, reasoning,
    recommended_actions, mitre_techniques, should_escalate, false_positive_reason, engine,
    model_name, prompt_version, latency_ms, tokens_used, raw_response, created_at
  ) VALUES (
    gen_random_uuid(),
    '{{ $('4. Insertar alerta (idempotente)').item.json.id }}'::uuid,
    '{{ $json.verdict }}',
    '{{ $json.recommended_severity }}',
    {{ $json.confidence }},
    {{ $json.risk_score }},
    '{{ $json.summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.reasoning || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.recommended_actions || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.mitre_techniques || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    {{ $json.should_escalate ? 'true' : 'false' }},
    NULLIF('{{ ($json.false_positive_reason || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    '{{ $json.engine }}',
    '{{ $json.model_name }}',
    '{{ $json.prompt_version }}',
    {{ $json.latency_ms }},
    {{ $json.tokens_used }},
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (alert_id) DO UPDATE SET
    verdict = EXCLUDED.verdict,
    recommended_severity = EXCLUDED.recommended_severity,
    confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
    risk_score = EXCLUDED.risk_score,
    summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
    reasoning = EXCLUDED.reasoning,
    recommended_actions = EXCLUDED.recommended_actions,
    mitre_techniques = EXCLUDED.mitre_techniques,
    should_escalate = EXCLUDED.should_escalate,
    false_positive_reason = EXCLUDED.false_positive_reason,
    engine = EXCLUDED.engine,
    model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name,
    prompt_version = EXCLUDED.prompt_version,
    latency_ms = EXCLUDED.latency_ms,
    tokens_used = EXCLUDED.tokens_used,
    raw_response = EXCLUDED.raw_response
  RETURNING alert_id, verdict, recommended_severity, risk_score
), updated AS (
  UPDATE alerts SET status = 'triaged',
    mitre_techniques = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.mitre_techniques || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = '{{ $('4. Insertar alerta (idempotente)').item.json.id }}'::uuid
)
SELECT * FROM saved;

INSERT INTO enrichment_data (
  id, alert_id, provider, indicator, indicator_type, status, risk_score, summary, payload, fetched_at
)
SELECT
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '{{ $('4. Insertar alerta (idempotente)').item.json.id }}'::uuid,
  COALESCE(item->>'provider', 'desconocido'),
  COALESCE(item->>'indicator', 'sin-indicador'),
  COALESCE(item->>'indicator_type', 'ip'),
  COALESCE(item->>'status', 'ok'),
  NULLIF(item->>'risk_score', '')::double precision,
  COALESCE(item->>'summary', ''),
  COALESCE(item->'payload', '{}'::jsonb),
  now()
FROM jsonb_array_elements('{{ JSON.stringify($('6. Triaje LangChain').item.json.enrichment || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb) AS item
ON CONFLICT (alert_id, provider, indicator) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  risk_score = EXCLUDED.risk_score,
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
  payload = EXCLUDED.payload,
  fetched_at = EXCLUDED.fetched_at;

  entity_type, entity_id, description, method, path, status_code, ip_address, user_agent,
  request_id, detail, duration_ms, created_at
) VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(), NULL, 'n8n@integracion', 'integration', 'TRIAGE', 'alerts',
  'Triaje automático n8n', NULL, 'alert',
  '{{ $('4. Insertar alerta (idempotente)').item.json.id }}',
  'Triaje LangChain persistido por workflow', 'POST', '/webhook/soc-lite-alert', 200, NULL, 'n8n',
  '{{ $execution.id }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ verdict: $('7. Guardar triaje').item.json.verdict, severity: $('7. Guardar triaje').item.json.recommended_severity, engine: $('6. Triaje LangChain').item.json.engine }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  NULL, now()
);

parameters.content:
## SOC-Lite · Triaje automático

**Flujo:** Webhook → normalización → filtro de severidad → inserción idempotente → LangChain → persistencia → enrutamiento → notificación/ticket → auditoría.

**Credenciales a reemplazar:** PostgreSQL, Slack y osTicket. Configure `SOC_AI_INTERNAL_KEY` en n8n y en el microservicio.

**Idempotencia:** `alerts.fingerprint` único con ventana de 5 minutos. Si la alerta ya existe, el nodo 4 no devuelve filas y el nodo 5 detiene la rama.

**Nota:** los nodos 6 y 7 usan las expresiones de n8n; valide el JSON en su instancia antes de activar.
